Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NotAStand: There is no empty Tank Stand here.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoBarrel: Needs a rain barrel, picked up and carried.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_BarrelNotEmpt: The barrel must be empty to lift it onto the stand.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoBarrelOnSta: There is no barrel on this stand.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_EmptyBarrelFi: Empty the barrel before taking it down.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TankGone: That tank is no longer there.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_OutOfReach: That tank is too far away to plumb to.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_AlreadyPlumbe: These tanks are already plumbed together.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NotPlumbed: These tanks are not plumbed together.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_CantLayHere: A line can't be laid here: it needs open, dry ground or floor.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoTankReach: Start a line beside a tank, or lay it on from a line already laid.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_JoinsTwoTaps: This would join two lines that each have a tap.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoLine: There is no garden line here.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoHoleMaker: Needs a tool that pierces this pipe: a hand drill for iron; an auger, a stone drill or a hammer and a nail for clay; an awl too for plastic and lead.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_MayCrack: Punching holes may crack this pipe.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_LineHasTap: This line already has a tap.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoTankForTap: No tank stands close enough to tap.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_NoPressure: The tank must stand a storey above the line.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_CisternsForKe: A University of Kentucky extension leaflet on keeping and moving farm water: a barrel on a log stand for pressure, and tanks piped together to share what the rain gives.
Tooltip_EnhancedIrrigation_TankStand: A log tower a storey high. A rain barrel set on its deck stands high enough to water a garden line below.
